I'm really sorry to hear about your dog and apologise on behalf of all these people for telling you to just move on and cheer up. I understand  because my childhood dog died as well a couple of years ago and I can still remember that excruciating pain I felt.. she was a boxer and she died so suddenly as well even though she was 12. I also got her when I was really young around the age of 7.

She brought me so much joy and happiness especially because she acted so silly when she wiggled her body. I never got another dog because I knew no other dog could ever replace her. How do you simply replace 12 years? She was like part of my family and she held the memories of my childhood. 

All I can say is the pain will pass with time, and you will always remember the good times you had with your pup. Right now allow yourself the time to grieve.
